claims: As of March 13, 2026, the Kentucky State Police have issued an IAN Alert for a missing 9-year-old girl in Boone County.
An IAN Alert is a Kentucky emergency system for missing children with autism or disabilities.
An IAN Alert acts similarly to an Amber Alert.
The purpose of IAN Alerts is to quickly notify the public when a child with autism or a mental disability goes missing and may be in danger.
IAN Alerts are named after Ian Sousis.
Ian Sousis was a 9-year-old with autism.
Ian Sousis drowned after wandering away.
Ian Sousis's case led to a new Kentucky law in 2024.
IAN Alerts utilize the same wireless emergency alert system as Amber Alerts.
Children with autism are at higher risk of drowning.
According to LEX18 and WKYT, a previous IAN alert issued on March 11, 2026, in Lexington for a 17-year-old was canceled after he was found safe.
